-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies QuickBooks OAuth credentials and connectivity by querying the CompanyInfo endpoint.

get-company-info.name: get-company-info
get-company-info.description: Retrieve QuickBooks Online company information — company name, legal name, country, currency, fiscal year start, tax form, address, email, phone, and website.

list-customers.name: list-customers
list-customers.description: List QuickBooks Online customers with optional filters. Search by name/email, filter by active status, and paginate with limit/offset. Returns key customer fields (Id, DisplayName, Active, Email, Balance, TotalRevenue).

params.query: Optional search term to filter customers by DisplayName (LIKE match). Case-insensitive.
params.active: Filter by active status. true = active only, false = inactive only, omit = all.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100).

get-customer.name: get-customer
get-customer.description: Retrieve a single QuickBooks Online customer by ID. Returns the full customer object with all fields including SyncToken (needed for updates).

create-customer.name: create-customer
create-customer.description: Create a new QuickBooks Online customer. Returns the created customer with Id and SyncToken. At minimum, a DisplayName is required.

params.displayName: Customer display name (required). Must be unique across all customers.
params.email: Primary email address for the customer.
params.givenName: Given (first) name — use for individual customers.
params.familyName: Family (last) name — use for individual customers.

update-customer.name: update-customer
update-customer.description: Update an existing QuickBooks Online customer. Requires customerId and syncToken (obtain syncToken via get-customer first). Only provided fields are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged. To deactivate a customer, set active=false.

params.customerId: The QuickBooks customer ID to update.
params.syncToken: The current SyncToken of the customer. Required for optimistic concurrency. Get it via get-customer.
params.active: Set to false to deactivate (make inactive) the customer. QuickBooks prefers deactivation over deletion.

list-vendors.name: list-vendors
list-vendors.description: List QuickBooks Online vendors with optional filters. Search by name, filter by active status, and paginate with limit/offset. Returns key vendor fields (Id, DisplayName, Active, Email, Balance).

params.query: Optional search term to filter vendors by DisplayName (LIKE match). Case-insensitive.
params.active: Filter by active status. true = active only, false = inactive only, omit = all.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100).

get-vendor.name: get-vendor
get-vendor.description: Retrieve a single QuickBooks Online vendor by ID. Returns the full vendor object with all fields including SyncToken (needed for updates).

create-vendor.name: create-vendor
create-vendor.description: Create a new QuickBooks Online vendor. Returns the created vendor with Id and SyncToken. At minimum, a DisplayName is required.

params.displayName: Vendor display name (required). Must be unique across all vendors.
params.email: Primary email address for the vendor.

update-vendor.name: update-vendor
update-vendor.description: Update an existing QuickBooks Online vendor. Requires vendorId and syncToken (obtain syncToken via get-vendor first). Only provided fields are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged. To deactivate a vendor, set active=false.

params.vendorId: The QuickBooks vendor ID to update.
params.syncToken: The current SyncToken of the vendor. Required for optimistic concurrency. Get it via get-vendor.
params.active: Set to false to deactivate (make inactive) the vendor. QuickBooks prefers deactivation over deletion.

list-invoices.name: list-invoices
list-invoices.description: List QuickBooks Online invoices with optional filters. Filter by customer, status (open/paid/void/all), and date range. Returns key invoice fields (Id, DocNumber, TxnDate, CustomerRef, TotalAmt, Balance, DueDate).

params.status: Filter by invoice status: "open" (Balance > 0), "paid" (Balance = 0), "void" (voided), "all" (no status filter). Default: "all".
params.dateFrom: Filter invoices from this date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.dateTo: Filter invoices up to this date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-12-31").
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100).

get-invoice.name: get-invoice
get-invoice.description: Retrieve a single QuickBooks Online invoice by ID. Returns the full invoice object with line items, customer reference, totals, and SyncToken (needed for updates/void).

create-invoice.name: create-invoice
create-invoice.description: Create a new QuickBooks Online invoice with line items. Returns the created invoice with Id, DocNumber, TotalAmt, and Balance. Each line item requires an itemId (ItemRef), quantity, and unitPrice.

params.customerId: The QuickBooks customer ID to bill.
params.txnDate: Transaction date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-20"). Defaults to today.
params.lineItems: Line items for the invoice. Each item requires itemId, quantity, and unitPrice.
params.billEmail: Billing email address for the invoice.
params.customerMemo: Memo visible to the customer on the invoice.

update-invoice.name: update-invoice
update-invoice.description: Update an existing QuickBooks Online invoice. Requires invoiceId and syncToken (obtain syncToken via get-invoice first). Only provided fields are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged.

params.invoiceId: The QuickBooks invoice ID to update.
params.syncToken: The current SyncToken of the invoice. Required for optimistic concurrency. Get it via get-invoice.
params.customerMemo: Updated memo visible to the customer.
params.privateNote: Updated private note (not visible to customer).
params.lineItems: Updated line items. Replaces all existing line items.

void-invoice.name: void-invoice
void-invoice.description: Void a QuickBooks Online invoice. The invoice record is preserved but marked as voided (Balance and TotalAmt set to 0). Requires invoiceId and syncToken. Use get-invoice to obtain the current syncToken.

params.invoiceId: The QuickBooks invoice ID to void.
params.syncToken: The current SyncToken of the invoice. Get it via get-invoice.

send-invoice.name: send-invoice
send-invoice.description: Send a QuickBooks Online invoice to the customer via email. If no email address is provided, uses the BillEmail stored on the invoice. Returns the delivery status.

params.invoiceId: The QuickBooks invoice ID to send.
params.email: Email address to send the invoice to. If omitted, uses the invoice BillEmail.

list-payments.name: list-payments
list-payments.description: List QuickBooks Online payments with optional filters. Filter by customer and date range. Returns key payment fields (Id, TxnDate, CustomerRef, TotalAmt, PaymentMethod).

params.dateFrom: Filter payments from this date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.dateTo: Filter payments up to this date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-12-31").
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100).

get-payment.name: get-payment
get-payment.description: Retrieve a single QuickBooks Online payment by ID. Returns the full payment object with line items (linked transactions), customer reference, and SyncToken (needed for deletes).

create-payment.name: create-payment
create-payment.description: Create a new QuickBooks Online payment. If invoiceId is provided, the payment is linked to that invoice via LinkedTxn. Returns the created payment with Id. Supports payment methods: cash, check, credit_card, bank_transfer.

params.customerId: The QuickBooks customer ID making the payment.
params.invoiceId: Optional invoice ID to link this payment to. Creates a LinkedTxn on the payment line.
params.txnDate: Transaction date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-20"). Defaults to today.
params.paymentMethod: Payment method. Maps to QuickBooks PaymentMethodRef.

delete-payment.name: delete-payment
delete-payment.description: Delete a QuickBooks Online payment. This permanently removes the payment record. Requires paymentId and syncToken. Use get-payment to obtain the current syncToken.

params.paymentId: The QuickBooks payment ID to delete.
params.syncToken: The current SyncToken of the payment. Get it via get-payment.

list-bills.name: list-bills
list-bills.description: List QuickBooks Online bills with optional filters. Filter by vendor, status (open/paid), and date range. Returns key bill fields (Id, TxnDate, DueDate, VendorRef, TotalAmt, Balance).

params.dateFrom: Filter bills from this date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.dateTo: Filter bills up to this date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-12-31").
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100).

get-bill.name: get-bill
get-bill.description: Retrieve a single QuickBooks Online bill by ID. Returns the full bill object with line items, vendor reference, and SyncToken (needed for updates and deletes).

create-bill.name: create-bill
create-bill.description: Create a new QuickBooks Online bill (vendor invoice). Requires a vendor ID and at least one line item with an expense account. Line items use AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail. Returns the created bill with Id and TotalAmt.

params.vendorId: The QuickBooks vendor ID for this bill.
params.txnDate: Transaction date (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-20"). Defaults to today.
params.dueDate: Due date for the bill (ISO format, e.g. "2026-10-20").
params.lineItems: Array of expense line items. Each item must have an accountId and amount.

update-bill.name: update-bill
update-bill.description: Update an existing QuickBooks Online bill. Requires billId and syncToken (obtain syncToken via get-bill first). Only provided fields are updated; omitted fields remain unchanged.

params.billId: The QuickBooks bill ID to update.
params.syncToken: The current SyncToken of the bill. Required for optimistic concurrency. Get it via get-bill.
params.vendorId: Update the vendor reference for this bill.
params.lineItems: Replace the bill line items. Each item must have an accountId and amount.
params.privateNote: Update the private note on the bill.

delete-bill.name: delete-bill
delete-bill.description: Delete a QuickBooks Online bill. This permanently removes the bill record. Requires billId and syncToken. Use get-bill to obtain the current syncToken.

params.billId: The QuickBooks bill ID to delete.
params.syncToken: The current SyncToken of the bill. Get it via get-bill.

list-accounts.name: list-accounts
list-accounts.description: List QuickBooks Online accounts (chart of accounts) with optional filters. Filter by account type (Bank, Accounts Receivable, Other Current Asset, Fixed Asset, Other Asset, Accounts Payable, Credit Card, Other Current Liability, Long Term Liability, Equity, Income, Cost of Goods Sold, Expense, Other Income, Other Expense, Non Posting) or by classification (Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Expense) and active status. Returns key account fields (Id, Name, AccountType, AccountSubType, CurrentBalance).

params.accountType: Filter by account type. Valid values: Bank, Accounts Receivable, Other Current Asset, Fixed Asset, Other Asset, Accounts Payable, Credit Card, Other Current Liability, Long Term Liability, Equity, Income, Cost of Goods Sold, Expense, Other Income, Other Expense, Non Posting.
params.classification: Filter by account classification (broad category). Useful when you want all asset, liability, or equity accounts regardless of specific type.
params.active: Filter by active status. true = active only, false = inactive only.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100).

get-account.name: get-account
get-account.description: Retrieve a single QuickBooks Online account by ID. Returns the full account object with type, subtype, balance, and SyncToken.

create-account.name: create-account
create-account.description: Create a new QuickBooks Online account in the chart of accounts. Requires a name and account type (Bank, Accounts Receivable, Other Current Asset, Fixed Asset, Other Asset, Accounts Payable, Credit Card, Other Current Liability, Long Term Liability, Equity, Income, Cost of Goods Sold, Expense, Other Income, Other Expense, Non Posting). Optionally specify an account subtype and currency. Returns the created account with Id.

params.name: The name of the account (e.g. "Office Supplies").
params.accountType: The type of account. Valid values: Bank, Accounts Receivable, Other Current Asset, Fixed Asset, Other Asset, Accounts Payable, Credit Card, Other Current Liability, Long Term Liability, Equity, Income, Cost of Goods Sold, Expense, Other Income, Other Expense, Non Posting.
params.currency: Currency code for the account (e.g. "USD", "EUR"). Defaults to the company currency.

list-items.name: list-items
list-items.description: List QuickBooks Online items (products and services) with optional filters. Filter by type (Service, Inventory, NonInventory) and active status. Returns key item fields (Id, Name, Type, UnitPrice, IncomeAccountRef).

params.active: Filter by active status. true = active only, false = inactive only.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100).

get-item.name: get-item
get-item.description: Retrieve a single QuickBooks Online item (product or service) by ID. Returns the full item object with type, price, account references, and SyncToken.

create-item.name: create-item
create-item.description: Create a new QuickBooks Online item (product or service). Requires a name, type (Service, Inventory, NonInventory), and an income account reference. Optionally specify unit price and expense account. Returns the created item with Id.

params.name: The name of the item (e.g. "Consulting Service").
params.incomeAccountRef: The income account ID for this item (sales revenue account).
params.unitPrice: The unit price (sales price) for this item.
params.expenseAccountRef: The expense account ID for this item (cost of goods sold account).
params.sku: Optional SKU (stock keeping unit) for the item.
params.taxable: Whether this item is taxable. Default: false.

report-profit-loss.name: report-profit-loss
report-profit-loss.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Profit & Loss (Income Statement) report for a date range. Returns the full report (Header, Columns, Rows) plus a simplified summary with total income, total expenses, and net income. Supports cash or accrual accounting method.

params.startDate: Start date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.endDate: End date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

report-balance-sheet.name: report-balance-sheet
report-balance-sheet.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Balance Sheet report as of a specific date. Shows assets, liabilities, and equity. Supports cash or accrual accounting method.

params.date: As-of date for the report (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

report-cash-flow.name: report-cash-flow
report-cash-flow.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Cash Flow report for a date range. Shows operating, investing, and financing activities and the net change in cash.

params.startDate: Start date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.endDate: End date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

report-aged-receivables.name: report-aged-receivables
report-aged-receivables.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Aged Receivables report as of a specific date. Shows outstanding customer balances grouped by aging buckets (Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91+ days). Returns the full report plus a simplified aging summary with bucket totals.

params.date: As-of date for the report (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

report-aged-payables.name: report-aged-payables
report-aged-payables.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Aged Payables report as of a specific date. Shows outstanding vendor balances grouped by aging buckets (Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91+ days). Returns the full report plus a simplified aging summary with bucket totals.

params.date: As-of date for the report (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

report-trial-balance.name: report-trial-balance
report-trial-balance.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Trial Balance report for a date range. Lists all accounts with their debit and credit balances, showing that total debits equal total credits.

params.startDate: Start date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.endDate: End date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

report-general-ledger.name: report-general-ledger
report-general-ledger.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online General Ledger report for a date range. Shows all transactions posted to each account, with debit and credit amounts. Optionally filter by account type.

params.startDate: Start date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.endDate: End date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").
params.accountType: Optional account type filter. Valid values: Bank, AccountsReceivable, OtherCurrentAsset, FixedAsset, OtherAsset, AccountsPayable, CreditCard, OtherCurrentLiability, LongTermLiability, Equity, Income, CostOfGoodsSold, Expense, OtherIncome, OtherExpense, NonPosting.

report-customer-balance.name: report-customer-balance
report-customer-balance.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Customer Balance report for a date range. Shows outstanding balances for each customer, including total amount owed and aging information.

params.startDate: Start date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.endDate: End date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

report-sales-by-customer.name: report-sales-by-customer
report-sales-by-customer.description: Generate a QuickBooks Online Sales by Customer report for a date range. Shows total sales revenue broken down by customer, with subtotals and grand total.

params.startDate: Start date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-01-01").
params.endDate: End date for the report period (ISO format, e.g. "2026-09-30").

name: QuickBooks Online
description: QuickBooks Online Accounting API — manage customers, invoices, payments, vendors, bills, accounts, items, and financial reports.

changelog.notes: Initial scaffold — OAuth 2.0 with Intuit, health check, and company info retrieval
